cognition_exposure_contract.non_objective_cognition: when history is enabled, record non_objective_cognition_call per configured ID without opening artifacts; when history is absent, record a no-history posture without opening artifacts
cognition_exposure_contract.prompt_treatment: eligible campaign projections only; retrieval status, unavailable IDs, and budget diagnostics remain upstream evidence
cognition_exposure_contract.history_withheld: do not open campaigns or include campaign projection or retrieval status in the prompt
cognition_exposure_contract.prompt_binding: canonical projection inclusion is checked before inference and the exact request prompt digest is revalidated on restart
cognition_exposure_contract.transfer_eligibility: exact model identity, same declared task family, different task digest, and disjoint probe inputs

required_binding: final invocation receipt and output digest
exact bounded output text verified against the invocation digest
score object digest and exact probe coverage

review_evidence_required: exact invocation purpose registration diff and authority-map digest

bounded maximum calls per trial and total campaign, with generation-token ceiling; protocol enforces input <= 8000 chars, output <= 4000 chars, <= 512 new tokens, <= 120 seconds, and one call per correlation
proof that request linkage binds the preregistered protocol, trial, strategy, and call index
proof that model serving receives no tools, developmental memory, host access, repository access, or external-action capabilities
proof that score plans and scorer outcomes are excluded from prompts and strategy history projections
resource-owner reconciliation and failure behavior for denied, cancelled, timed-out, or incomplete calls
reviewer identity, reviewed source revision, decision, and any conditions recorded as a digest-bound artifact

exact_nodes.expected: The campaign cannot be published without a separately persisted exact protocol custody record; all invocation receipt timestamps must be timezone-aware and no earlier than the preregistration timestamp. The report labels this wall-clock ordering as untrusted local time.

A persisted protocol binds one frozen task, exact ordered probe inputs, model identity, model ID, authority-map digest, invocation budget, generation configuration, and two or more explicit strategy descriptors with per-trial invocation bounds. Its trial count is balanced across cyclic strategy positions, each trial has a digest-bound order, and history-condition labels cannot satisfy strategy identity.

Every admitted invocation receipt binds its exact trial index and digest, resource attempt ID, allocation digest, and measured/reconciled receipt digests; each call has a unique correlation ID across the full campaign and joins to exactly one attempt_begun, measured, reconciled chain with matching predecessor and effect digests. Missing, duplicate, extra, substituted, reused-correlation, or cross-trial rows become incomparable.

The resource owner exports one bounded full-ledger image that passes the ledger's read-only digest and invariant validator. Every exact-scope trial projection binds that image's digest; the evaluator compares projected allocations, attempts, and receipt chains to the reconstructed image and rejects altered digests, omitted rows, unrelated invocation scope, incomplete chains, and non-recorded owner disposition.

Every trial score is recomputed by the versioned private-plan scorer and has a durable receipt binding protocol digest, frozen task-plan digest, final invocation receipt and output digest, score digest, and exact ordered probe coverage. Restart reconstruction reruns scoring and reproduces each receipt before report acceptance. A strategy is eligible only if it meets the quality threshold on every trial; ranking then uses total correct probes and total terminal reconciled call units across the full campaign.

The campaign's single full-ledger image passes the resource ledger's read-only digest and invariant validator after restart, all owner projections match that reconstructed image, and rerunning the evaluator reproduces the exact report; any digest or semantic mismatch fails closed.
No strategy meeting the quality requirement, unresolved ties, unknown cost, and incomplete evidence remain explicit outcomes without a recommendation.
Existing history_present, history_withheld, and history_restored records cannot be reinterpreted or admitted as task-strategy comparison outcomes.
